I5.quote: This manuscript describes cost-effective synthesis of heteroatom self-doped activated biocarbons from sword bean shells (ACBS) by a simple two-step process of carbonization and activation using different weight ratios of KOH/chars.

notes: Original article, Electrochimica Acta 325 (2019) 134941. H2 uptake was measured on the gas phase at 77 K: up to 40 bar on an HPVA-100 (the paper calls it a gravimetric analyser) and up to 1 bar on an ASAP 2020 HD88 (Section 2.3.5). The paper also reports supercapacitor electrochemistry in 6 M KOH (Section 3.7), but this is separate from the H2 uptake, so the electrochemical code does not apply. SBET was measured by N2 at 77 K on the same four ACBS samples (Section 2.3.4, Table 2). No retraction notice in the text, record.json is_retracted is false, and the paper does not state that its H2 values were published before. The Maxsorb 3 H2 values in Table 3 are marked 'This work'. No supplementary file was supplied (main text only).
